text: The initiative is government-led and involves multiple agencies, integrating landslide risk into disaster risk reduction governance. It emphasizes lifeline continuity, mainstreaming hazard information into planning approvals, and aligns with Sendai targets. Unique features include engineering slope stabilization, road corridor protection, and community awareness programs.

metadata.solution_name: Government-led Landslide Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Fiji (2020–2025)
